title: Wi-Fi not connecting
solution: Toggle Wi-Fi off and on from the network settings panel.
Forget the network and reconnect using the correct password.
Restart the router/access point and wait 60 seconds before reconnecting.
Update the wireless network adapter driver.
Run the built-in network troubleshooter.

title: VPN connection failing
solution: Verify internet connectivity is working outside the VPN.
Confirm VPN credentials and that the account is not locked.
Restart the VPN client application.
Switch VPN protocol (e.g., from UDP to TCP) in client settings.
Check if a firewall or antivirus is blocking the VPN port.

title: Slow internet speed
solution: Run a speed test to confirm the actual download/upload speed.
Disconnect unused devices from the network to free bandwidth.
Connect via Ethernet cable to rule out Wi-Fi interference.
Clear DNS cache and switch to a public DNS (e.g., 1.1.1.1).
Restart the modem/router.

title: No internet access despite connection
solution: Flush DNS cache using ipconfig /flushdns (Windows) or equivalent.
Renew IP address (ipconfig /release then /renew).
Set DNS servers manually to a reliable public DNS.
Restart the network adapter from Device Manager.
Check if a proxy setting is incorrectly enabled.

title: Printer not printing
solution: Check the printer is powered on and has paper/toner.
Clear the print queue and restart the print spooler service.
Confirm the printer is set as the default device.
Reinstall or update the printer driver.
Verify the printer is on the same network as the computer.

title: Laptop won't turn on
solution: Confirm the charger is connected and the LED indicator is lit.
Hold the power button for 15 seconds to force a hard reset.
Remove the battery (if removable) and reconnect after 30 seconds.
Try a different power outlet or charging cable.
If no response, escalate for hardware inspection.

title: Battery draining fast
solution: Check Task Manager/Activity Monitor for high battery-consuming apps.
Lower screen brightness and disable keyboard backlight.
Turn off Wi-Fi/Bluetooth when not in use.
Run the built-in battery health/report tool.
Update the BIOS and power management drivers.

title: External monitor not detected
solution: Check the video cable (HDMI/DisplayPort) is firmly connected on both ends.
Press Windows+P (or equivalent display shortcut) and select the correct display mode.
Update the graphics card driver.
Try a different cable or port to rule out a hardware fault.
Restart the computer with the monitor already connected.

title: Keyboard not working
solution: Check for physical debris under the keys and clean gently.
Reconnect or re-pair the keyboard (for wireless/Bluetooth).
Update or reinstall the keyboard driver in Device Manager.
Test the keyboard on another device to isolate the fault.
Try a different USB port.

title: Application keeps crashing
solution: Update the application to the latest version.
Restart the computer to clear temporary memory conflicts.
Run the application as administrator.
Check application logs or Event Viewer for the crash error code.
Reinstall the application if crashes persist.

title: Software update failing
solution: Ensure there is enough free disk space for the update.
Check internet connection stability during download.
Clear the update cache/temporary files.
Run the update as administrator.
Restart the device and retry the update.

title: License activation error
solution: Verify the license key was entered correctly with no extra spaces.
Confirm system date and time are set correctly.
Check if the license has expired or reached the seat limit.
Deactivate the license on any old device before reactivating.
Contact the software vendor if the key shows as invalid.

title: Installation stuck or fails
solution: Run the installer as administrator.
Temporarily disable antivirus during installation.
Free up disk space and clear temporary installer files.
Download a fresh copy of the installer in case of file corruption.
Check compatibility with the current operating system version.

title: Forgot password / need reset
solution: Use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page to receive a reset email.
Check spam/junk folder for the reset email if not received.
Ensure the new password meets complexity requirements.
Clear browser cache/cookies if the reset link fails to load.
Contact the helpdesk to manually trigger a reset if self-service fails.

title: Account locked out
solution: Wait 15-30 minutes as accounts often auto-unlock after a lockout period.
Verify you are using the correct username/email.
Check for Caps Lock being accidentally enabled while typing the password.
Request a manual unlock from IT support with identity verification.
Review recent login attempts for possible unauthorized access.

title: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) not working
solution: Confirm the device clock is synced (MFA codes are time-sensitive).
Try a backup MFA method (SMS, backup codes, email).
Reinstall the authenticator app if codes are consistently wrong.
Request MFA reset from IT support with identity verification.
Check network connectivity if using push notification-based MFA.

title: Forgot username
solution: Use the 'Forgot Username' recovery option with your registered email.
Check a previous welcome/onboarding email for your assigned username.
Contact IT support with proof of identity for lookup.
Check your organization's employee/student directory if available.

title: Outlook not syncing
solution: Check internet connection and mail server status.
Toggle 'Work Offline' mode off if accidentally enabled.
Repair the Outlook profile via Control Panel > Mail.
Verify mailbox storage isn't full.
Recreate the email profile if sync issues persist.

title: Cannot send email
solution: Check the message isn't exceeding the attachment size limit.
Confirm outgoing (SMTP) server settings are correct.
Check if the recipient address is valid and correctly formatted.
Clear the Outbox and resend the message.
Verify the account isn't flagged for suspicious sending activity.

title: Mailbox full warning
solution: Delete large attachments or old emails from Inbox and Sent Items.
Empty the Deleted Items/Trash folder.
Archive old emails to local/PST storage.
Request a mailbox quota increase from IT if genuinely needed.
Set up auto-archiving rules for future prevention.

title: Suspicious phishing email received
solution: Do not click any links or download attachments in the email.
Report the email using the 'Report Phishing' button if available.
Forward the email to the security team for analysis.
Delete the email after reporting.
Do not reply to or unsubscribe from suspicious senders.

title: Suspicious login alert
solution: Change your password immediately from a trusted device.
Review active sessions and sign out of unfamiliar devices.
Enable multi-factor authentication if not already active.
Check account recovery info (email/phone) hasn't been altered.
Report the incident to the security team immediately.

title: Antivirus not updating
solution: Check internet connectivity for the antivirus update service.
Manually trigger an update from the antivirus dashboard.
Restart the antivirus service or the computer.
Verify the antivirus subscription/license hasn't expired.
Reinstall the antivirus client if updates repeatedly fail.

title: Computer running slow
solution: Check Task Manager for high CPU/memory/disk usage processes.
Disable unnecessary startup applications.
Free up disk space by clearing temporary files.
Run a malware scan to rule out background infections.
Consider a RAM or storage (SSD) upgrade if hardware is outdated.

title: Disk space full warning
solution: Run Disk Cleanup to remove temporary and system files.
Uninstall unused applications.
Move large files to external/cloud storage.
Empty the Recycle Bin/Trash.
Check for large hidden log or cache files consuming space.

title: Windows update stuck
solution: Wait at least 30-60 minutes as some updates are slow.
Restart the computer if truly frozen for over an hour.
Run the Windows Update Troubleshooter.
Clear the Software Distribution cache folder.
Manually download the update from the Microsoft Update Catalog.

title: System won't boot / blue screen
solution: Note the stop code shown on the blue screen for diagnosis.
Boot into Safe Mode to isolate a driver/software conflict.
Run System Restore to a previous stable point.
Check for recently installed drivers or updates to roll back.
Escalate for hardware diagnostics if the issue persists after Safe Mode.
